tours.title: A Day in the Engine Room
tours.summary: What's due, closing a task with parts used, running hours, and reporting a defect.

steps.title: Your Day at a Glance
steps.text: Every crew member starts on their own dashboard: what's overdue, due today, open defects, the calendar and the notice board. Everything is one click away.

steps.title: The Task List
steps.text: Planned maintenance comes from scheduled tasks, by date or by running hours, whichever comes first. Filter by due date, equipment or who's responsible, and save the view you use.

pre.value: Both pre-filters changed, housings cleaned, no leaks on restart.

steps.title: Closing a Task
steps.text: Close it with notes, photos, the running hours and the spare parts used. Stock comes off the inventory automatically and the next occurrence is scheduled.

steps.title: Running Hours
steps.text: Enter the hour counters once and every hour-based task updates. Hours can also come straight from the engine room logbook.

steps.title: Every Machine's Record
steps.text: Each piece of equipment has its own page: what's coming up, its full history, spares, manuals and photos, filed in a vessel database laid out by SWBS group.

steps.title: Defects, Tracked to the Fix
steps.text: Anyone can report a defect, with photos. It gets a corrective task and stays open until the work is done and signed off.

tours.title: The Captain's View
tours.summary: Every department at a glance, reports, crew rotation, certificates and the yard list.

steps.title: All Departments on One Page
steps.text: Overdue work, low stock, spending and logbooks waiting to be signed, for every department, without opening each one.

steps.title: Into a Department
steps.text: Open any department to see its overdue work and the next 30 days, read only, exactly as its crew sees it.

pre.waitFor: Overdue at the End of the Period

steps.title: Reports in Seconds
steps.text: The monthly maintenance report, work done, parts used and more, for any period. Save it as PDF, Excel or CSV, or file it in the documents.

steps.title: Crew Rotation
steps.text: Who's on board and who's on leave, a year at a time, with clashes flagged and handover notes ready for each change-over.

steps.title: Certificates and Surveys
steps.text: Vessel certificates with their survey windows. Renewal tasks are raised in good time, so nothing expires unnoticed.

steps.title: The Snag List
steps.text: Every department adds snags as they find them. Print the list for the yard when the vessel goes in.

tours.title: On Deck, on a Phone
tours.summary: Rounds, logbook pages and procedures from a phone, even with no signal.

steps.title: Made for Phones Too
steps.text: Rocinante installs like an app on any phone, tablet or computer on the vessel's network. No app store, nothing to set up.

steps.title: Walking a Round
steps.text: Tick each check as you go. Scan a QR label to jump straight to the right point. Ticks made without signal are kept and sent later.

steps.title: Found a Problem?
steps.text: Mark a check defective, say what failed and add a photo. It becomes a defect report for the head of department.

steps.title: The Logbook
steps.text: Engine room and deck logs, filled in on the spot and signed off by the head of department. Readings can feed the running hours.

steps.title: Procedures in Your Pocket
steps.text: Step-by-step procedures with photos. Keep one on your phone and it works with no signal at all.

tours.title: Spares, Stores and the Wine Cellar
tours.summary: Spares with a ledger and storage plan, purchasing, and the wine cellar.

steps.title: Every Spare, Accounted For
steps.text: Stock levels, reorder points, where it's stored and a ledger of every movement. Parts used on tasks come off automatically.

steps.title: Purchasing
steps.text: What's on order, what's arrived and what's still outstanding, with each delivery put away into the right box.

steps.title: The Wine Cellar
steps.text: The interior team's cellar: every bottle, where it's kept and what's running low.

steps.title: Each Bottle's Story
steps.text: Stock, location and every movement in and out. Take bottles out from a phone, scan labels, and run a stocktake at the end of a charter.

tours.title: Ask the Assistant
tours.summary: Ask questions in plain English; answers come from your own records and manuals.

steps.title: Ask in Plain English
steps.text: Each department can have its own AI assistant. It answers from the vessel's own records and manuals, and only shows what that person is allowed to see. (The answer here is a demo example.)

steps.title: Procedures and the Safety System
steps.text: SOPs, the safety management system, incident reports, drills and audits sit alongside the maintenance, so the whole vessel works from one place.
